parsed.summary: Tracing the three sub-sheets against the specification, the functional architecture matches: the TPS2121 mux (U4) has IN1=+12V, IN2=+5V, OUT=VBUS with PR1/OV1/OV2/CP2/ST/GND to ground, ILIM=51.1k and SS=10nF; the AP63203WU buck (U3) has IN/EN=VBUS, FB tied to the 3V3 output, SW→3.9µH with a 100nF bootstrap; the TPS1H200 heater switch (U5) has VS=+12V, IN/DIAG_EN both on the GPIO1 net, OUT to the screw terminal, CL/GND/EP to ground and FAULT to a test point only; the three MAX31855 channels share SCK/SO and use three independent CS lines that map to the GPIOs the spec names; USB CC lines use 5.1k pulldowns and D+/D- reach GPIO18/19; the WS2812 and TVS-protected fan/USB lines are present. The only differences from the spec are reference‑designator renumbering (ESP32=U6, mux=U4, heater switch=U5, buck=U3, etc.) and test‑point/passive re‑labeling, which are naming/ordering conventions, not electrical deviations, and the spec is silent on the exact GPIOs for the fans and status LED. I could not find a drawing‑supported deviation from the intended design.
